review_basis: Retained source data and source-pinned reconciliation, not a new external retrieval.

deployment_source.locator: Deployment CSV: header row 1, exact data row and project ID recorded per dossier.

baseline_boundary: The registry is an approved-proposal identity and denominator baseline. Raw codes remain untranslated unless an official schema is joined. No row establishes executed agreement, construction, service, subscriber adoption, test passage, retention, affordability, state acceptance, or closeout.
shared_explanation: Dates in the deployment source are estimates: subaward March 4, 2026, performance start April 3, 2026, and performance end April 2, 2030. The passage of a scheduled date does not establish an executed agreement, actual start, completion or service. Raw technology codes remain untranslated here. All outcome observations remain empty; they are not zero-valued results.
privacy_boundary: Project-level totals only. No individual broadband-location identifiers or anchor-institution details are published.

records.title: Blackfoot / Missoula broadband project
records.answer: This is Blackfoot’s separately identified Missoula proposal project, not the whole cooperative, all Montana broadband or a measured result for Missoula County.
records.review_state: Accepted as a bounded proposal-stage reader dossier; not an operating-outcome admission

sections.heading: Identity and denominator
sections.text: The retained baseline associates this project with 3,724 broadband-serviceable location rows and 24 community-anchor-institution rows. Those are separate proposal inventories: adding them and calling the result connected households would change both the unit and the claim. The project ID is the stable join key for later reports; the Missoula name is not a verified service-area polygon.

sections.heading: Funding is not expenditure
sections.text: The proposal carries US$26,234,612 in BEAD support and US$8,744,870 in subgrantee match. These amounts identify planned financing, not disbursements or the value of accepted construction. A later payment record must name this project before it can update the financial account.

sections.heading: Project-specific evidence boundary
sections.text: The baseline flags an intersection with tribal land and names Flathead in the tribal-consent field. That field is not itself a signed consent instrument. Retain its exact project relationship, while seeking any applicable executed agreement, mapped scope and separately documented consent before making an authorization claim.

sections.heading: Identity and denominator
